description: This file defines API route handlers for managing 'activities' in a CRM backend, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting activities. It uses FastAPI for web routing, SQLAlchemy ORM for database interactions, and custom schemas for request/response models.

methods.name: ActivityOut update_activity(activity_id: int, payload: ActivityUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))

methods.name: Response delete_activity(activity_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db), user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Endpoint to delete an activity by its ID.
